headline: 给编程代理装技能包成了今天的主线，Superpowers 单日大涨，设计词表与少写代码的方法论一起涌进 Claude Code 和 Codex。
headlineEn: Skill packs for coding agents led the day as Superpowers surged, while design vocabulary and write-less methods landed in Claude Code and Codex.

lead.name: obra/superpowers
lead.zh: 一套可组合技能加上强制使用它们的初始指令，把开发方法论接到各类编码代理上。
lead.en: Composable skills plus bootstrap instructions that make coding agents follow a full development methodology.
lead.why: 今天涨星最多的不是新模型，而是把技能、工作流和初始指令绑在一起的代理方法论，覆盖 Claude Code、Cursor 与 Codex。
lead.whyEn: The day's largest star gain came from a methodology that binds skills, workflow, and bootstrap instructions across Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex.

sections.title: 给编码代理的技能、词表和少写规矩
sections.titleEn: Skills, design vocabulary, and write-less rules

items.name: pbakaus/impeccable
items.zh: 把界面品味写成代理能执行的指令，先打磨再评审，减少发版前的廉价生成痕迹。
items.en: Turns visual taste into commands a coding agent can follow, then review the result before it ships.

items.name: affaan-m/ECC
items.zh: 面向 Claude Code 与 Codex 的运行时层，补技能、记忆、安全，并要求先调研再动手。
items.en: A runtime layer for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Cursor that adds skills, memory, security, and a research-first loop.

items.name: DietrichGebert/ponytail
items.zh: 仓库 README 称同一代理在 Claude Code 基准上少写百分之五十三的代码、少花百分之四十一的时间。
items.en: The README reports the same Claude Code agent producing less code and spending less time on a fixed task set.

items.name: Granular.Build
items.zh: 在可视化工作区里让 AI 代理开始干活。
items.en: A visual workspace for putting AI agents on actual tasks.

sections.title: 终端编码代理与供应商切换
sections.titleEn: Terminal coding agents and provider switching

items.name: farion1231/cc-switch
items.zh: 桌面端集中切换 Claude Code、Codex 等的接口供应商，并管理 MCP、技能和提示词。
items.en: A desktop manager to switch API providers and keep MCP, skills, and prompts in one place for Claude Code and Codex.

items.name: earendil-works/pi
items.zh: 精简可扩展的代理套件，含统一模型接口、循环、终端界面和编码 CLI。
items.en: A small agent harness with a unified model API, loop, terminal UI, and coding CLI you can extend.

items.name: anomalyco/opencode
items.zh: 开源的终端编码代理，可用安装脚本或包管理器落地。
items.en: An open-source coding agent for the terminal, installable via script or package managers.

items.name: Claude Ship
items.zh: 官方标语是代码能写多快，就能交付多快。
items.en: The listing frames delivery as matching the pace at which you write code.

items.name: Viktor Code
items.zh: 编码代理熟悉仓库，这款产品则声称熟悉你的公司。
items.en: Aimed at the gap between repo-aware coding agents and company-level context.

sections.title: 代理配置扫描与本地模型

items.name: erkamyaman/safe-anything
items.zh: 扫描代码中的注入、密钥泄露和依赖漏洞，也覆盖 AI 代理相关配置。
items.en: A Rust scanner for injection flaws, leaked secrets, dependency CVEs, and risky AI agent setups.

items.name: ollama/ollama
items.zh: 在本地拉起 Kimi、GLM、MiniMax、DeepSeek、Qwen 等模型。
items.en: Run Kimi, GLM, MiniMax, DeepSeek, Qwen and other models on your own machine.
